name: knowledge-navigator
description: A private, local-first research knowledge navigator for mathematics, artificial intelligence, and programming.

scripts.validate: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js validate
scripts.compile: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js compile
scripts.inspect: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js inspect
scripts.search: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js search
scripts.schema: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js schema
scripts.sidebars: npm run build:core --silent && node packages/core/dist/cli.js sidebars
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @navigator/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @navigator/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @navigator/web
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @navigator/api && npm run compile && npm run build --workspace @navigator/web
scripts.dev: npm run compile && npm run dev --workspace @navigator/api
